title: Delete dormant Engram work-authority grant retirement subsystem
outcome:
After the cut-B no-agent-grants landing, remove the remaining TermAl-internal grant retirement/tombstone machinery and serde-skipped compatibility carriers from EngramProjectSettings, session runtime descriptors, StateInner/PersistedState, session_crud, and legacy tests. The shipping contract already omits grants from API/UI/persistence/Verify/MCP/host frames; this follow-up prevents dormant pre-cut-B shims from becoming permanent. Do not broaden the cut-B landing's runtime behavior while deleting it.

PRECONDITION - MET (verified 2026-09-26: Termal::Fable at Engram HEAD 7af8e96; Engram::Fable against the installed binary and both live stores, read-only). Engram has no agent-side authority grants: no `authority grant` or `authority revoke` command (the operator `authority waive-obligation` remains); no grant material in the bind protocol - ControlWorkBinding carries claim identity and fence only (Engram domain/control.rs 283-290: root_execution_id, work_id, run_id, work_revision, claim_id, claim_fence); no grant, token or lease table or column in the store. Landed in Engram 182c123 (2026-09-02, "cut B": project memories, no grant on the agent path, strict host frames) and 950a6f1 (2026-09-23, bind control sessions directly, remove retired lease authority); dcd034a deleted the one-time conversions. "cut-B" alone names only the first half - cite the substance plus both commits. Citable Engram text: CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md "Architecture Boundaries" (a fenced work claim schedules live execution; claims do not grant filesystem or external-action authority); docs/spec.md 301-302, 663, 1079, 1419; docs/shipped.md 60-71; docs/architecture.md 86; docs/roadmap.md 29-32; Engram tracker w-1398b5f7ea43, w-7c5b8838c6c0, w-ab22491d7cf6 (all completed). Evidence: Engram/src outside tests has zero hits for work_authority_grant|AuthorityGrant|grant_token|revoke; `engram --version` = "engram 0.1.0 build 6e160087008d (exe a7c10bde292e, schema 81b4b805acfb)"; `engram authority --help` lists waive-obligation only; `engram authority grant --help` = unrecognized subcommand; sqlite read-only over both live stores: the only grant tables are control_turn_grants and control_turn_grant_supersessions (host-side turn mediation), the only authority-named columns are control_policy_versions.authority_id and memory_heads.authority; control_sessions has no grant or token column. Stability as of 2026-09-26: no open Engram item, branch or design reintroduces agent-side authority; per-action mediation (spec.md 1071-1076) is not built and would be a host-directed grant after a spec change. No seam needed.

ENGRAM DEPENDENCE: none. Engram models no retirement, revocation or confirmation; a revoke sent today fails as an unrecognized subcommand; nothing on Engram's side waits for TermAl's ledger or revoke runner. This bead is pure removal on TermAl's side with no Engram change.

DELETION SURFACE (TermAl at b77f1fa: 113 non-test + 142 test references to work_authority_grant|retired_work_authority): the serde-skipped carrier in EngramProjectSettings (src/engram_host_adapter.rs ~125-128) and the dormant revoke runner (~1663-1760); retirement/tombstone machinery in src/session_crud.rs (~286-538, 696-815; 94 references); the persisted `engram_retired_work_authority_grants` ledger (src/persisted_state.rs:33 and 4 more; src/state.rs 7); src/wire.rs 1; src/engram_mcp_config.rs 1; tests: src/tests/engram_host_adapter.rs (131) plus engram_authority_fixture.rs and single references in tests/codex_thread_recovery.rs, engram_boot_recovery_targets.rs (3), engram_compaction.rs, engram_session_reconciliation.rs (3), engram_root_recovery_live.rs, shared_codex_thread_setup.rs, session_settings.rs. Persisted state: a ledger stored by an older build is dropped on load, never migrated (Greg: no legacy, reset rather than migrate), and never re-emitted.

MUST NOT SEND after the deletion (Engram host.rs 33-80, HostControlRequest is deny_unknown_fields): any grant-shaped field on any host frame; `authority revoke` / `authority grant`; a non-empty delivery_tokens on turn_begin (refuses the begin); a turn_evaluate purpose other than ordinary. Engram tolerates `purpose` and `delivery_tokens` only "while hosts still send it" (host.rs 52-65); dropping them is a separate TermAl follow-up, not this bead.

MOOTS when landed: tm-uw7j.1 (bound the retired ledger) and tm-68cx (preserve the grant on a redacted PATCH; in_progress on the dormant path). Greg decides their close. Coding: Termal::Opus (Greg, 2026-09-26).
acceptance:
- rg -n 'work_authority_grant|retired_work_authority|AuthorityGrant|revoke' src/ (tests included) returns nothing that names the retired subsystem; the revoke runner and engram_authority_fixture.rs are gone.
- cargo check clean; cargo test --bin termal green; rustfmt clean.
- PersistedState written by a build that stored engram_retired_work_authority_grants loads without error and without the ledger (fixture with the old JSON); the field is absent from the new persisted output; no migration code is added.
- EngramProjectSettings serializes with no grant carrier; a settings PATCH carrying workAuthorityGrant follows the existing unknown-field policy (state which: rejected or ignored) and never retains the value.
- The host frames TermAl sends to Engram are byte-identical for the same inputs before and after (fixture comparing serialized session_bind, turn_begin and turn_checkpoint), so the cut-B runtime behaviour is not broadened.
- No Engram command is added or changed; the only Engram CLI calls after the change are the ones the shipping adapter already makes.
- docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md (and docs/architecture.md where it mentions retirement or the ledger) drop that text; the precondition above is cited as substance plus Engram 182c123 and 950a6f1, never as "cut-B" alone.
